decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-750 MODIFY already records the JLCPCB Basic-component preference and integrated-board scope. The single-board decision does not necessarily invalidate its BOM-readiness, part-sourcing, or approved-component attributes.
The existing MODIFY adds integrated-board scope but leaves obsolete five-volt and enable interboard connector routes in state even though the client explicitly eliminates interboard connectors.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I was thinking, if you have time for a new project and are willing to do it, that we try to make as cheap as possible single board for this project. So everything will be on one board and from start we try to match JLCPCB Basica component (as much as possible). It will have much less connectors as there are no interboard connectors. Also if you have some idea on how to make something better/cheaper but have same functionality you can suggest. I can add it as new milestone to this project and we can agree on price. What do you think does it make sense?

decisions.reason: The existing MODIFY adds the integrated-board context but incorrectly retains separate MAIN_BOARD and POWER_BOARD applicability after everything is consolidated onto one board. The external charge-LED interface itself is not necessarily removed.
